offering_description.value: Operates online sports betting, iGaming (casino, poker, bingo) and daily fantasy platforms for consumers. Also runs retail betting shops in some markets. Delivered through proprietary apps and websites.

primary_products.value: online sportsbook; online casino games; online poker; daily fantasy sports; online bingo and lottery

primary_services.value: sports betting operation; iGaming operation; fantasy sports contests; retail betting shop operation

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual bettors and online gamers, sports fans, casino and poker players

end_markets.value: online gambling; sports betting; iGaming; fantasy sports; consumer entertainment

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: net gaming revenue from betting margins, casino wagers, poker rake and contest entry fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates licensed betting platforms, apps and retail shops, serving consumer bettors; brand owner: owns consumer gambling brands and proprietary trading technology

geography_served.value: global: US, UK and Ireland, Australia, Italy, Spain, Brazil, India and other regulated markets

specialization.value: related lines: sports betting, iGaming, poker and fantasy products sharing customers and technology

distribution_channels.value: online: proprietary mobile apps and websites; own locations: company-run retail betting shops in the UK and Ireland; partners / resellers: affiliate marketers and media partners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gambling licenses required in each jurisdiction, state gaming commissions, UK Gambling Commission and other national regulators
